lines.text: His soul thirsts for the living God like a deer panting for streams, and his tears are his food.
He remembers leading the festive procession to God's house, and remembers God from Jordan and the peaks of Sinai.
He says all God's breakers and waves have rolled over him, and at night God's song is with him.
He asks God his Rock why He has forgotten him, and calls God his Shepherd and his God.
He asks God to send light and truth to lead him, and he will praise God with the harp.
